clusters.headline: Chancellor Merz Advances Ilse Aigner For German Presidential Role
aiSummaryBullets: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has proposed Ilse Aigner as the conservative bloc's candidate for the German presidency.
Aigner has stated she will not engage in discussions with the far-right Alternative for Germany party during her candidacy meetings.

clusters.headline: German Authorities Execute Raids Against Gremium Motorcycle Club
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement conducted early-morning operations targeting chapters of the Gremium MC biker gang.
The actions took place in the southwestern region of Germany.
